originality.rationale: The claim is an exact three-way modal-algebra image-rank classification with a cross-frame bounded-morphism count, not a claim to the known KD45 frame normal form or classical rooted-forest identity. Full-text study of Sliusarev (2024) identifies connected KD45 structure and almost-sure modal validities without this classification. The Pitman (2001/2002) sources provide a stronger general forest identity but do not identify the bounded KD45 endomorphism semigroup and all three modal-algebra spectra. Targeted published-finding corpus and web comparisons found no direct equivalent. A latent transformation-monoid antecedent remains a residual originality risk; targeted negative searches cannot exclude that possibility.
